about.title: About DalGains
about.medical_disclaimer: DalGains provides general nutrition tracking based on published Indian food composition data (IFCT 2017). It is not a substitute for advice from a doctor, registered dietitian, or other qualified health professional. Do not use DalGains to diagnose or treat any medical condition. If you have a health condition, are pregnant, or are planning significant dietary changes, consult a professional.
about.data_notice: Your logs are stored on DalGains' servers. We do not sell your data, share it with advertisers, or use it for anything beyond running the app for you. You can export or delete your data at any time from Settings.
about.contact_body_no_email: Questions about your data? Contact the person who runs this DalGains installation.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These are the plain-language terms for using DalGains.
terms.section_use_body: Use DalGains to track your own nutrition. Don't use it to diagnose or treat a medical condition -- see the medical disclaimer on the About page.
terms.section_no_warranty_body: DalGains is provided as-is, with no guarantee of accuracy for any specific food or recipe. Nutrition data comes from IFCT 2017 and USDA (as a fallback) -- always check with a professional for anything medically important.
terms.section_open_source_body: DalGains is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Anyone can read, modify, and redistribute the source code, under the same license -- see the footer on any screen for a link.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data DalGains collects, where it's stored, and how you can access, correct, or delete it.
privacy.what_we_collect_body: Only what you enter yourself: your name, age, sex, height, weight, activity level, dietary preferences, meal logs, and (if you choose to log it) your weight over time. We don't collect anything else, and we don't track you across other apps or websites.
privacy.where_stored_body: Your data is stored in a database on this DalGains installation's own server -- not shared with, or processed by, any third party except for sending you a sign-in link by email.
privacy.your_rights_body: You can export a copy of your data or delete it entirely at any time from Settings. Deleting your data removes your profile immediately; contact the email below if you'd like your account itself removed too.
privacy.dpdp_body: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, DalGains acts as a data fiduciary for the health-adjacent data you provide (meal logs, weight). We process it only for the purpose you gave it to us for -- running your own nutrition tracking -- and you have the right to access, correct, and erase it at any time, as described above.
privacy.contact_body: For data access, correction, or deletion requests: {{email}}.
privacy.contact_body_no_email: For data access, correction, or deletion requests, contact the person who runs this DalGains installation.
